description: PostgreSQL 18 int2/int4 boundaries, arithmetic overflow, assignment, defaults, arrays, and result type promotion
sql: SELECT (-32768)::int2 AS int2_min, 32767::int2 AS int2_max, (-2147483648)::int4 AS int4_min, 2147483647::int4 AS int4_max;
CREATE TABLE type_matrix_integer_boundaries (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, small_value INT2 DEFAULT 0, regular_value INT4);
UPDATE type_matrix_integer_boundaries SET small_value = small_value + 1 WHERE id = 'edge';
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_integer_boundaries WHERE small_value + 1::int2 > 0;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_integer_boundaries ORDER BY small_value + 1::int2;
SELECT id, small_value, regular_value FROM type_matrix_integer_boundaries ORDER BY id;
